subject: Your 28-day milestone unlocked
preview_text: What you've accomplished in a month of smarter predictions—check your stats now

Every match you analyze builds your edge. And here's the kicker: you've already earned credits, unlocked streaks, and maybe even climbed the IQ Quiz leaderboard. That's real momentum.

But the best part? You haven't even tapped your full potential yet. Dive into your personal stats—see your prediction accuracy, your top leagues, and how your AI confidence scores stack up against the crowd. It's like a highlight reel of your brain getting sharper.

Open the app now and check your 28-day wrap-up. Your next win is just a tap away. P.S. Premium users are already seeing 24% better accuracy on value bets—your 3-day trial is still waiting if you want to unlock it.
